verses.text: People make plans in their hearts, but the answer they speak comes from the LORD.
People think all their ways are clean, but the LORD weighs what drives them.
Put what you do in the LORD's hands, and your plans will succeed.
The LORD made everything for its purpose, even the wicked for the day of trouble.
The LORD detests every proud heart. Count on it, they won't get away without punishment.
Mercy and truth make atonement for wrongdoing. Reverence for the LORD turns people away from evil.
When someone's ways please the LORD, he makes even their enemies live at peace with them.
A little gained by doing right beats a huge income gained through injustice.
Your heart plans where you're headed, but the LORD guides your steps.
Inspired judgments come from the king's lips. He must be true to what he says.
Honest scales and balances belong to the LORD. Every weight in the bag is his work.
It's detestable for kings to do wrong, because doing what's right keeps the throne secure.
Kings delight in honest words. They value people who tell the truth.
The king's anger is a messenger of death, but a wise person knows how to calm it.
There's life in the light of the king's face. His favor is like a cloud that brings spring rain.
Getting wisdom is so much better than getting gold. Choose understanding over silver.
The upright take the road that leads away from evil. Watch where you walk and you'll guard your life.
Pride comes before ruin, and an arrogant spirit comes before a fall.
It's better to stay humble with the poor than to split stolen goods with the proud.
Pay attention to the Word and you'll find prosperity. Blessed is anyone who trusts the LORD.
People who are wise at heart are known for good judgment. Pleasant words make teaching easier to take in.
Understanding is a fountain of life to those who have it. Fools are punished by their own foolishness.
A wise heart teaches the mouth what to say and makes its words more instructive.
Kind words are like honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones. 🍯
A road can look right to you and still end in death.
Hunger works in a laborer's favor. An empty mouth keeps them going.
A worthless person plots harm. Their words burn like a scorching fire.
Someone who twists what's right stirs up fights. A whisper can split close friends apart.
A violent person draws their neighbor in and leads them down a road that's no good.
Someone who winks while plotting twisted things, who presses their lips together, is set on doing evil.
Gray hair is a crown of glory, earned through a life of doing what's right.
Someone who's slow to anger is better than a warrior. Ruling your own spirit beats taking a city.
You can cast the lot into your lap, but every outcome comes from the LORD.
